G5200.def:
ὑγρός, -ά, -όν,
[in LXX: Jz 16:7,8 (לַח), Jó 8:16 (רָשׂב), Sir.39:13
wet, moist, opposite to ξηρός: of wood, sappy, green: Lc 23:31.†
(AS)

G5201.def:
ὑδρία, -ας, ἠ
(ὕδωρ), [in LXX for בַּד ;]
__1. prop., a water-pot or jar: Jo 2:6, 7 John 4:28.
__2. More frequently in Attic = ἄγγυς, a pot, urn or jar of any kind, as for holding wine, coins, etc. (see Rutherford, NPhr., 23; MM, xxv).
† (AS)

G5202.def:
ὑδροποτίω, -ῶ
(ὕδωρ, πίνω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 1:12 שָׁתָה מַיִם) * ;]
to drink water, opposite to οἴνῳ χρῆσθαι: 1Tm 5:23 (Hdt., i, 71; Plat., Rep., 561 with, al.).†
(AS)

G5204.def:
ὕδωρ
genitive,
ὕδατος, τό,
[in LXX chiefly for מַיִם ;]
water: Mt 3:16, Mc 1:10, Lc 7:44, Jo 4:7, Tg 3:12, Ap 8:10, al.; pl., Mt 14:28-29, Jo 3:23, Ap 1:15, al.; βαπτίζειν (ἐν) ὕδατι, Mt 3:11, Mc 1:8, Jo 1:26, al.; τ. λυυτρὸν τοῦ ὕ., Ef 5:26; opposite to οἴνος, Jo 2:9 4:46; αἷμα, Jo 19:34, Hb 9:19, 1Jo 5:6 Jn 5:8 Mt 17:15 Mc 9:22; πνεῦμα, Jo 1:26, 31 1:33; πνεῦμα καὶ πῦρ, Mt 3:11, Lc 3:16;ἐξ ὕ. κ. πνεύματος γεννηθῆναι, Jo 3:5; metaphorically, of divine truth and grace (τ.) ὕ. (τ.) ζῶν, Jo 4:10-11 (cf. Jo 4:13-15); τ. ὕ. τ. ζωῆς, of spiritual refresh­ment, Ap 21:6 22:1, 17
(AS)

G5205.def:
ὑετός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὕω, to rain), [in LXX chiefly for ;]
rain: At 14:17 28:2, Hb 6:7, Tg 5:18, Ap 11:6; ὄψιμος (which see), sc. ὑ., Tg 5:7.†
(AS)

G5206.def:
υἱοθεσία, -ας, ἡ
(cf. the cl. phrases, υἱὸν τίθεσθαι, θετὸς υἱός), frequently in Inscr. (see Deiss., BS, 239), adoption of a son (or daughter); metaphorically, of God's relation established
__(a) with Israel: Rm 9:4;
__(b) with Christ­ians: Rm 8:15, Gl 4:5, Ef 1:5; of its consummation, Rm 8:23.†
(AS)

G5207.def:
υἱός, -οῦ, ὁ, [in LXX very frequently and nearly always for בֵּן, Gn 4:17, al.; for בַּר, Dan LXX TH 7:13, al.; etc. ;],
a son;
__1. in the ordinary sense: Mt 10:37, Mc 9:17, Lc 1:13, al. mult.; omitted with the art. of origin (WM, §30, 3; Bl., §35, 2), τὸν τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, At 13:22 (LXX); also with genitive anarth. (cl.), Σώπατρος Πύρρου Βεροιαῖος, At 20:4; with adj., προτότοκος, Lc 2:7; μονογένης, Lc 7:12; opposite to νόθος, Hb 12:8; in a wider sense, of posterity: ὁ υἱ. Δαυΐδ, of the Messiah (cf. Dalman, Words, 316ff.; DCG, ii, 653f.), Mt 22:42, 45 Mc 12:35, 37 Lc 20:41, 44 al.; υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ, (cf. υἷες Ἀχαιῶν, Hom., Il., i, 162, al.), Mt 27:9, At 9:15, al.
__2. Metaphorical;
__(a) as belonging to, being connected with or having the quality of that which follows (a usage mainly due to translation from a Semitic original; cf. Deiss., BS, 161ff.; Dalman, Words, 115f.; DCG, ii, 652f.): τ. πονεροῦ (διαβόλου), Mt 13:38, At 13:10; τ. νυμφῶνος (see: νυμφών), Mt 9:15, Mc 2:19, al.; τ. φωτός (Lft., Notes, 74), Lc 16:8, Jo 12:36, 1Ts 5:5; τ. εἰρεήμης, Lc 10:6; γεέννης, Mt 23:15; τ. ἀπωλείας, Jo 17:12, 2Ts 2:3; τ. αἰῶνος τούτου, Lc 16:8 20:34; τ. ἀπειθειάς, Ef 2:2 5:6; βροντῆς, Mc 3:17; τ. ἀναστάσεως, Lc 20:36; παρακλήσεως, At 4:36; τ. προφητῶν κ. τ. διαθήκης, At 3:25;
__(b) υἱὸς τ. θεοῦ (cf. Dalman, Words, 268ff.; Deiss., BS, 166f.; DB, iv, 570 ff.; DCG, ii, 654ff.), of men, as partakers of the Divine nature and of the life to come: Mt 5:9, Lc 20:36, Rm 8:14 9:26, al.; υἱοὶ (κ. θυγατέρες) τ. ὑψίστου, Lc 6:35, 2Co 6:18; in an unique sense of Jesus, Mt 4:3 8:29 28:19, Mc 3:4, Lc 4:41, Jo 9:35 11:27, al.; ὁ Χριστὸς ὁ υἱ. τ. θεοῦ ζῶντος (τ. εὐλογητοῦ), Mt 16:16, Mc 14:61;
__(with) (ὁ) υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου (in LXX for Heb. בּן אדם, Aram, בּר אנשׁ; cf. Dalman, Words, 234ff.; DB, iv, 579ff.; DCG, ii, 659ff.; Westc., St. John, i, 74ff.; other reff. in Swete, Mk, 2:10), based on the Aram. of Dn 7:13, where the phrase, like the corresponding Heb. (as in Sl 8:5), means a man, one of the species, and indicates the human appearance of the person in question. It is used of the Messiah in Enoch, with 46, §1-4, also in II Et 13:3, 12, al. Our Lord first makes the phrase a title, using the def. art. It seems to combine the ideas of his true humanity and representative character. Exc. in At 7:56 and (anarth.) Ap 1:13 14:14, it is used of Jesus only by himself: Mt 8:20, Mc 2:10, Lc 5:24, Jo 1:52, al.
(AS)

G5208.def:
ὕλη, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX: Jó 19:29 (†) Jó 38:40 (סֻכָּה), Sl 69:2 B.l א (יָוֵן), Is 10:17 (שָׁמִיר), Wis.11:17 15:13, Sir.28:10, 2Ma.2:24, 4Ma.1:29 * ;]
__1. wood, forest, woodland (Thus., Xen., al.).
__2. wood, timber, fuel (Hom., Hdt., Thuc., al.): Tg 3:5 (see Hort, Ja., 70, 104 f.).
__3. = Lat. materia, esp. in Philosophy, matter (Arist. and later writers; Wis, ll. with).†
(AS)

G5214.def:
ὑμνέω, -ῶ
(ὕμνος) [in LXX for הָלַל pi., שִׁיר, יָדָה hi., etc. ;]
__1. trans., with accusative of person(s) (in cl. also with accusative of thing(s)), to sing to, laud, sing to the praise of: At 16:25, Hb 2:12.
__2. Intrans., to sing: in LXX and NT, of singing hymns and praises to God (Sl 65:13, al.), Mt 26:30, Mc 14:26 (see Swete, in l).†
(AS)

G5215.def:
ὕμνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for תְּהִלָּה, נְגִינָה, שִׁיר, etc. ;]
a hymn;
__(a) in cl. a festal song in praise of gods or heroes;
__(b) in LXX and NT a song of praise addressed to God: Ef 5:19, Cl 3:16.†
SYN.: ψαλμός, that which is sung to a musical accompaniment; ᾠδή, the generic term for song (cf. Tr., Syn., § LXXviii, Lft. on Cl 3:16) (AS)

G5217.def:
ὑπ-άγω
[in LXX: Êx 14:21 (הָלַךְ hi.), elsewhere only as seel., Tob.8:21, al. ;]
a word of the vulgar language, in Pres. and imperfect only (Bl., § 53, 1).
__I. Trans.
__1. to lead or bring under, subdue (Hom., Hdt., al.; Ex, l.with).
__2. to lead on slowly (Hdt., Xen., al.).
__II. Intrans., to go slowly away, withdraw oneself, depart (so less frequently in cl.; Thuc., Eur., al.): absol., Mt 8:32 13:44, Mc 6:33, Lc 8:42 17:14, Jo 6:67 8:2 11:44 14:5, 28 18:8; οἱ ἐρχόμενοι κ. οἱ ὑπάγοντες, Mc 6:31; ὑπῆγον κ. ἐπίστευον, Jo 12:11; ἵνα ὑπαγῆτε κ. καρπὸν ψέρητε, Jo 15:16; opposite to ἔρχεσθαι, Jo 3:8 8:14; imperat., ὕπαγε, Mt 4:10 8:13 20:14, Mc 2:9 T, Mc 7:29 10:52; εἰς εἰρήνην (ἐν εἰ.), Mc 5:34, Tg 2:16; id. prefixed to another imperat. (Bl., § 79, 4), Mt 5:34 8:4 18:15 19:21 21:28 27:65 28:10, Mc 1:44 10:21 16:7, Jo 4:16 9:7, Ap 10:8; with καί inserted, Ap 16:1; euphemistically, of death, Mt 26:24, Mc 14:21; with adv.: ποῦ (which see), Jo 12:35 14:5 16:5, 1Jo 2:11; ὅπου (which see), Jo 8:21-22 13:33, 36 14:4 Ap 14:4; ἐκεῖ, Jo 11:8; with prep.: πρός, Jo 7:33 13:3 16:5, 10 16:17; εἰς, Mt 9:6 20:4, 7, Mc 2:11 11:2 14:13, Lc 19:30, Jo 6:21 7:3 9:11 11:31, Ap 13:10 17:8, 11; εἰς . . . πρός, Mt 26:18, Mc 5:19; ἐπί, Lc 12:58; μετά, Mt 5:41; ὀπίσω, Mt 16:23, Mc 8:33; with inf., Jo 21:3.†
(AS)

G5218.def:
ὑπακοή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑπακούω), [in LXX: 2Rs 22:36 (עֲנָוָה); in Aq.: 2Rs 23:23 * ;]
obedience (opposite to παρακοή);
__1. in general, absol., εἰς ὑ., Rm 6:16; with genitive subjc., 2Co 7:15 10:6, Phm 21; with genitive obj., Rm 1:5 (Lft, Notes, 246) Rm 16:26, 1Pe 1:22; τ. Χριστοῦ, 2Co 10:5.
__2. Of obedience to God's commands: absol., 1Pe 1:2; opposite to ἁμαρτία, Rm 6:16; τέκνα ὑπακοῆς, 1Pe 1:14; with genitive subj., Rm 15:18 16:19.
__3. Of Christ's obedience: absol., Hb 5:8; with genitive subj., Rm 5:19.
(The word is not found except in LXX, NT and eccl.).†
(AS)

G5219.def:
ὑπακούω
[in LXX: chiefly for שָׁמַע ;]
to listen, attend, hence,
__(a) to answer a knock at a door (Plat., Xen., al.): At 12:13;
__(b) to attend to, submit to, obey (Hdt., Thuc., al.): absol., Fp 2:12; with inf., Hb 11:8; with dative of person(s) (Plat., al.; but more frequently with genitive), Mt 8:27, Mc 1:27 4:41, Lc 8:25 17:6, Rm 6:16, Ef 6:1, 5, Cl 3:20, 22, Hb 5:9, 1Pe 3:6; with dative of thing(s), At 6:7, Rm 6:12 10:16, 2Ts 1:8 3:14; before εἰς (by attraction, for dative; see ICC, in l), Rm 6:17.†
(AS)

G5220.def:
ὕπανδρος, -ον
[in LXX: Nm 5:20, 29 (אִישׁ תַּחַת), Pv 6:24, 29, Sir.9:9 41:21 * ;]
under or subject to a man, married: γυνή, Rm 7:2 (Polyb., Diod., al.).†
(AS)

G5221.def:
ὑπ-αντάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Dan LXX 10:14 (קָרָה), Sir.9:3, al. ;]
to go to meet, meet: with dative of person(s) (see M, Pr., 64), Mt 8:28 28:9, Mc 5:2, Lc 8:27 17:12 (ἀπ-, WH, txt.), Jo 4:51 11:20, 30 12:18, At 16:16; of meeting in battle, Lc 14:31.†
(AS)

G5222.def:
ὑπ-άντησις, -εως, ἡ
(ὑπαντάω), [in LXX: Jz 11:34, εἰς ὑ. (קִרְאָה), etc. ;]
a going to meet: εἰς ὑ. (see M, Pv 14:1-35 n), Mt 8:34 25:1, Jo 12:13.†
(AS)

G5223.def:
ὕπαρξις, -εως, ἡ
(ὑπάρχω), [in LXX for רְכוּשׁ, הוֹן, etc. ;]
__1. subsistence, existence (Arist., al.).
__2. In late writers, = τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, substance, property: Hb 10:34; pl., At 2:45.†
(AS)

G5225.def:
ὑπάρχω
[in LXX for הָיָה, יֵשׁ, לוּן, etc.; τ. ὑπάρχοντα for מִקְנֶה, רְכוּשׁ, etc. ;]
__1. to begin, make a beginning (Hom., Hdt., al.).
__2. to be in existence, be ready, be at hand (Hdt., Thuc., al.): At 19:40 27:12, 21; before ἐν, At 28:18.
__3. to be, prop, expressing continuance of an antecedent state or condition (cf. Gifford, Incarnation, 11 ff.; MM, xxv): with, nom, pred., Lc 8:41 9:48, At 4:34 7:55 8:16 16:3 19:36 21:20, 1Co 7:26 12:22, Tg 2:15, 2Pe 3:11; ptcp. with pred., Lc 16:14 23:50, At 2:30, 32 17:24 22:3, Rm 4:19, 1Co 2:15, 2Co 8:17 12:16, Gl 1:14 2:14; pl., Lc 11:13, At 16:20, 37 17:29, 2Pe 2:19; before ἐν, with dative of thing(s), Lc 7:25 16:23, At 5:4 10:12, 1Co 11:18, Fp 3:20; ἐν μορφῇ θεοῦ ὑπάρχων (R, mg., being originally), Fp 2:6; ἐν, with dative of person(s), (among), 1Co 11:18; μακρὰν ἀπό, At 17:27; πρὸς τ. σωτηρίας, At 27:34.
__4. to belong to (Thuc., Xen., al.): with dative of person(s), At 3:6 4:37 28:7, 2Pe 1:8; τὰ ὑπάρχοντα, one's belongings, possessions: with dative of person(s), Lc 8:3 12:15, At 4:32; with genitive of person(s), Mt 19:21 24:47 25:14, Lc 11:21 12:33, 44 14:33 16:1 19:8, 1Co 13:3, Hb 10:34 (cf. προ-υπάρχω).†
(AS)

G5226.def:
ὑπ-είκω
[in LXX: 4Ma.6:35 * ;]
__1. to retire, withdraw.
__2. to yield, submit: metaphorically, Hb 13:17.†
(AS)

G5227.def:
ὑπ-εναντίος, -α, -ον
[in LXX for אָיַב, צַר, etc. ;]
set over against, opposite. Metaphorical (Plat., Arist., al.), opposed to, contrary to: with dative of person(s), Cl 2:14; absol., as subst., ὁ ὑ., Hb 10:27 (cf. Is 26:11).†
(AS)

G5228.def:
ὑπέρ (when following subst.—poët.—ὕπερ; so as adv., 2Co 11:23),
prep. with genitive, accusative
__I. C. genitive, primarily of place (rest or motion), over, above, across, beyond, hence, metaphorically,
__1. for, on behalf of: of prayer, Mt 5:44, At 8:24, Rm 10:1, Tg 5:16, al.; of laying down life, Jo 10:11, Rm 9:3, al.; esp. of Christ giving his life for man's redemption, Mc 14:24, Jo 10:15, At 21:13, Rm 5:6-8, al.; opposite to κατά, Mc 9:40, Lc 9:50, Rm 8:31.
__2. Causal, for, because of, for the sake of: with genitive of person(s), At 5:41, Rm 1:5, Fp 1:29, 2Co 12:10, al.; with genitive of thing(s), Jo 11:4, Rm 15:8, 2Co 1:6, al.
__3. = ἀντί (see M, Pr., 105), for, instead of, in the name of: 1Co 15:29, 2Co 5:15, 21 Gl 3:13, Cl 1:7, Phm 13 (cf. Field, Notes, 225).
__4. In more colourless sense, = περί (M, Pr., l.with), for, concerning, with regard to: Rm 9:27, 2Co 1:6 8:23 12:8, Fp 1:7, 2Ts 2:1, al.

__II. C. accusative, primarily of place, over, beyond, across, hence, metaphorically, of measure or degree in excess, above, beyond, over, more than: Mt 10:24, 37 Lc 6:40, At 26:13, 1Co 10:13, 2Co 1:8, Ef 1:22 3:20, Phm 16, al.; after comparatives = than (Jz 11:25, al.), Lc 16:8, Hb 4:12.

__III. As adv. (see supr. ad init.), more: ὕπερ ἐγώ, I more, 2Co 11:23; in compounds, see: ὑπεράνω, ὑπερλίαν, ὑπερπερισσῶς.

__IV. In composition: over (ὑπεραίρω), beyond (ὑπερβάλλω), more (ὐπερνικάω), on behalf of (ὐπερεντυγχάνω).
(AS)

G5229.def:
ὑπερ-αίρω
[in LXX: 2Cr 32:23 (נָשָׂא ni.), etc. ;]
to lift or raise over. Mid., to uplift oneself: 2Co 12:7; before ἐπί, with accusative, of person(s), 2Ts 2:4 (cf. 2Ma.5:23).†
(AS)

G5231.def:
ὑπερ-άνω
compound adv., [in LXX for עַל, מֵעָל, etc. ;]
above: as prep. with genitive, Ef 1:21 4:10, Hb 9:5.†
(AS)

G5233.def:
ὑπερ-βαίνω
[in LXX for עָבַר, etc. ;]
__1. trans., to step over, trans­gress (R, overreach: 1Ts 4:6).
__2. Intrans., to transgress: metaphorically, 1Ts 4:6 (R, txt.; see M, Th., in l).†
(AS)

G5235.def:
ὑπερ-βάλλω
[in LXX: Jó 15:11 A (†), Sir.5:7 25:11, al. ;]
__1. trans., to throw over or beyond.
__2. Intrans., to run beyond. In both senses, metaphorically, to exceed, surpass, transcend: 2Co 3:10 9:14, Ef 1:19 2:7; with genitive obj., Ef 3:19.†
(AS)

G5236.def:
ὑπερ-βολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑπερβάλλω), [in LXX: καθ᾽ ὑ., 4Ma.3:18 * ;]
a throwing beyond. Metaphorical, excess, superiority, excellence: 2Co 4:7 12:7; καθ᾽ ὑπερβολήν, beyond measure, exceedingly, Rm 7:13, 1Co 12:31, 2Co 1:8, Gl 1:13; κ. ὑ. εἰς ὑ., beyond all measure, 2Co 4:17.†
(AS)

G5237.def:
ὑπερ-εῖδον, aor.
[in LXX for עָלַם hi., מַעַל, etc. ;]
to overlook: with accusative of thing(s), At 17:30
(AS)

G5238.def:
ὑπερ-έκεινα
comp. adv. (see Bl., 28, 2; M, Pr., 99),
beyond: as prep. with genitive, τὰ ὑ. ὑμῶν, 2Co 10:16 (Byz. and Ec 1:1-18.).†
(AS)

G5240.def:
ὑπερ-εκ-χύννω (Rec. -ύνω), late form of -χέω
to pour out over. Pass., to overflow, run over: Lc 6:38 (not elsewhere).†
(AS)

G5241.def:
ὑπερ-εν-τυγχάνω
to intercede or make petition for (see Deiss., BS, 121 f.): before ὑπέρ, Rm 8:26.†
(AS)

G5242.def:
ὑπερ-έχω
[in LXX: Gn 25:23 (אָמַץ), Êx 26:13 (עֲדַף), Sir.36:7, al. ;]
__1. trans., to hold over or above.
__2. Intrans. (when a noun follows, the case is governed by the prep.; see Bl., § 34, 1; 36, 8), to rise above, overtop; metaphorically,
__(a) to be superior in rank, etc.: Rm 13:1, 1Pe 2:13 (cf. Wis.6:6);
__(b) to be superior, excel, surpass: with genitive (cl.; see supr.), Fp 2:3; with accusative (cl.; see supr.), Fp 4:7; as subst., τ. ὑπερέχον, the excel­lency, the surpassing worth, Fp 3:8.†
(AS)

G5243.def:
ὑπερηφανία, -ας, ἡ
(ὑπερήφανος, which see), [in LXX chiefly for גָּאוֹן and cogn. forms ;]
haughtiness, arrogance, disdain: Mc 7:22 (Plat., Xen.).†
(AS)

G5244.def:
ὑπερήφανος, -ον
(ὑπέρ, φαίνομαι, with η pleonast., see Kühner3, I, 189) [in LXX for זֵד, גֵּאֶה, לוּץ, etc. ;]
showing oneself above others;
__(a) in good sense (Plat., al.), pre-eminent, splendid;
__(b) more frequently in had sense, and so always in Scr., arrogant, haughty, disdainful (see Westc. Epp. Jo., 65b): Rm 1:30, 2Tm 3:2; διανοίᾳ καρδίας, Lc 1:51; opposite to ταπεινός (as in Pv 3:34), Tg 4:6, 1Pe 5:5" (LXX) .†
SYN.: ἀλαζών, ὑβριστής, see Tr., Syn., § xxix (AS)

G5245.def:
ὑπερ-νικάω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Da TH Dn 6:3; in Sm.: Sl 43:1 * ;]
to be more than conqueror: Rm 8:37 (eccl.).†
(AS)

G5246.def:
ὑπέρ-ογκος, -ον
[in LXX: Dt 30:11 (פָּלָא), etc. ;]
of excessive weight or size; metaphorically, excessive, immoderate, in late writers, of arrogant speech (see Mayor on Ju, l.with): n. pl., 2Pe 2:18, Ju 16.†
(AS)

G5247.def:
ὑπεροχή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑπερέχω) [in LXX: Jr 52:22 (קוֹמָה), 2Ma.3:11, al. ;]
a projection, eminence, as the peak of a mountain. Metaphorical (Arist.), excellence, pre-eminence: λόγου ἢ σοφίας, 1Co 2:1; οἱ ἐν ὑ (for a parallel to this phrase, see Deiss., BS, 255, and cf. 2Mac, l.with), 1Tm 2:2.†
(AS)

G5248.def:
ὑπερ-περισσεύω
to abound more exceedingly: Rm 5:21. Mid., in same sense (RV, overflow): with dative of thing(s), 2Co 7:4.†
(AS)

G5250.def:
ὑπερ-πλεονάζω
to abound exceedingly: 1Tm 1:14 (Ps Sol 5:19; Herm., Mand., v, 2, 5).†
(AS)

G5251.def:
ὑπερ-υψόω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Sl 37:35 (עָרִיץ) Sl 97:9 (עָלָה ni.), Da TH Dn 4:34 11:12 (רוּם), ib. LXX TH Dn 3:52 ff.* ;]
__1. to exalt beyond measure, exalt to the highest place: Fp 2:9.
__2. to extol (Da, ll. with).†
(AS)

G5252.def:
ὑπερ-φρονέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: 4Ma.13:1 4Mac 14:11 4Mac 16:2 * ;]
__1. to be overproud, high-minded (Æsch.): μὴ ὑ. παρ᾽ ὃ δεῖ φρονεῖν (on the paranom., see Vau., in l), Rm 12:3.
__2. to overlook, think slightly of (Thuc., Plat.).†
(AS)

G5253.def:
ὑπερῷον, -ου, τό
(neut. of ὑπερῷος, above, ὑπέρ) [in LXX for עֲלִיָּה and cogn. forms ;]
__1. in cl., the upper story or upper rooms where the women resided (Hom., a1.).
__2. In LXX and NT, an upper chamber, roof-chamber, built on the flat roof of the house (see DB, iii, 674a): At 1:13 9:37, 39 20:8 (cf. 4Ki.23:22).†
(AS)

G5254.def:
ὑπ-έχω
[in LXX: Sl 89:50 (נָשָׂא), La 5:7 (סָבַל), Wis.12:21, 2Ma.4:48 * ;]
to hold or put under. Metaphorical, to undergo, suffer: δίκην, Ju 7 (Soph., Eur., al.).†
(AS)

G5255.def:
ὑπήκοος, -ον
(ὑπακσύω), [in LXX: Jo 17:13 (לָמַם) Pv 21:28 (שָׁמַע), etc. ;]
giving ear, obedient, subject: Fp 2:8; with dative of person(s), At 7:39; εἰς πάντα, 2Co 2:9.†
(AS)

G5256.def:
ὑπηρετέω, -ῶ
(ὑπηρέτης) [in LXX: Wis.16:21, 24-25 19:6, Sir.39:4 * ;]
prop., to serve as rower on a ship (Diod., al.). In cl. always metaphorically, to minister to, serve: with dative of person(s), At 13:36 20:34 24:23.†
(AS)

G5257.def:
ὑπηρέτης, -ου, ὁ
(ὑπό + ἐρέτης, a rower) [in LXX: Pv 14:35 (עֶבֶד), Wis.6:4, al. ;]
prop., an under rower; hence, generally, a servant, attendant, minister: of a magistrate's attendant, Mt 5:25; of officers of the Synagogue or Sanhedrin, Mt 26:58, Mc 14:54, 65, Lc 4:20, Jo 7:32, 45-46 18:3, 12 18:22 19:6, At 5:22, 26; of the attendants of kings, οἱ ὑ. οἱ ἑμοί Jo 18:36; of Christian ministers, At 13:5 26:16; ὑπηρέται λόγου, Lc 1:2; Χριστοῦ, 1Co 4:1; δοῦλοι κ. ὑ., Jo 18:18.†
SYN.: see: διάκονος (AS)

G5258.def:
ὕπνος, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX for שֵׁנָה, חֲלוֹם, etc. ;]
sleep: Mt 1:24, Lc 9:32, Jo 11:13, At 20:9; metaphorically, Rm 13:11.†
(AS)

G5259G.def:
ὑπό (before smooth breathing ὑπ᾽, Mt 8:9b, Lc 7:8b; before rough breathing ὑφ᾽, Rm 3:9; on the neglect of elision in Mt, Lk, ll. witha, Gl 3:22, see WH, App., 146; Tdf., Pr., iv),
prep. with genitive, dative (not in NT), accusative
__I. C. genitive, primarily of place, under, hence, metaphorically, of the efficient cause, by: after passive verbs, with genitive of person(s), Mt 1:22, Mc 1:5, Lc 2:18, Jo 14:21, At 4:11, 1Co 1:11, Hb 3:4, al.; with genitive of thing(s), Mt 8:24, Lc 7:24, Rm 3:21, al.; with neut. verbs and verbs with pass, meaning, Mt 17:12, Mc 5:26, 1Co 10:9, 10 1Ts 2:14, al.
__II. C. accusative, under;
__1. of motion: Mt 5:15 8:8, Mc 4:21, Lc 13:34; hence, metaphorically, of subjection, Rm 7:14, 1Co 15:27, Gl 3:22, 1Pe 5:6, al.
__2. Of position: Jo 1:49, At 4:12, Rm 3:13, 1Co 10:1, al.; hence, metaphorically, under, subject to, Mt 8:9, Rm 3:9, 1Co 9:20, Gl 4:5, al.
__3. Of time, about: At 5:21.
__III. In composition: under (ὑποδέω), hence, of subjection (ὑποτάσσω), compliance (ὑπακούω), secrecy (ὑποβάλλω), diminution (ὑποπνέω).
(AS)

G5259H.def:
ὑπό (before smooth breathing ὑπ᾽, Mt 8:9b, Lc 7:8b; before rough breathing ὑφ᾽, Rm 3:9; on the neglect of elision in Mt, Lk, ll. witha, Gl 3:22, see WH, App., 146; Tdf., Pr., iv),
prep. with genitive, dative (not in NT), accusative
__I. C. genitive, primarily of place, under, hence, metaphorically, of the efficient cause, by: after passive verbs, with genitive of person(s), Mt 1:22, Mc 1:5, Lc 2:18, Jo 14:21, At 4:11, 1Co 1:11, Hb 3:4, al.; with genitive of thing(s), Mt 8:24, Lc 7:24, Rm 3:21, al.; with neut. verbs and verbs with pass, meaning, Mt 17:12, Mc 5:26, 1Co 10:9, 10 1Ts 2:14, al.
__II. C. accusative, under;
__1. of motion: Mt 5:15 8:8, Mc 4:21, Lc 13:34; hence, metaphorically, of subjection, Rm 7:14, 1Co 15:27, Gl 3:22, 1Pe 5:6, al.
__2. Of position: Jo 1:49, At 4:12, Rm 3:13, 1Co 10:1, al.; hence, metaphorically, under, subject to, Mt 8:9, Rm 3:9, 1Co 9:20, Gl 4:5, al.
__3. Of time, about: At 5:21.
__III. In composition: under (ὑποδέω), hence, of subjection (ὑποτάσσω), compliance (ὑπακούω), secrecy (ὑποβάλλω), diminution (ὑποπνέω).
(AS)

G5260.def:
ὑπο-βάλλω
[in LXX: ??Dn 3:9 A, I Et 2:18 * ;]
to throw or put under. Metaphorical,
__(a) to subject, submit;
__(b) to suggest, whisper, prompt;
__(with) to suborn (see Field, Notes, 113), instigate: with accusative of person(s), At 6:11.†
(AS)

G5261.def:
ὑπογραμμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὑπογράφω, (a) to write under; (b) to trace letters for copying), [in LXX: 2Ma.2:28 * ;]
__1. a writing-copy, hence,
__2. an example: 1Pe 2:11 (Philo).†
(AS)

G5262.def:
ὑπό-δειγμα, -τος, τό
(ὑποδείκνυμι), [in LXX: Eze.42:15, Sir.44:16, 2Ma.6:28 2Mac 6:31, 4Ma.17:23 * ;]
used by later writers (Xen. onwards) for παράδειγμα (see Rutherford, NPhr., 62),
__(a) a figure, copy: Hb 8:5 9:23;
__(b) an example: for imitation, Jo 13:15, Tg 5:10; for warning, Hb 4:11, 2Pe 2:6.†
SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑποτύπωσις (see DB, iii. 696b) (AS)

G5263.def:
ὑπο-δείκνυμι
[in LXX for נָגַד hi., etc. ;]
__1. to show secretly.
__2. to show by tracing out; hence, generally, to teach, make known: with dative of person(s), Lc 6:47 12:5, At 9:16; id. with inf., Mt 3:7, Lc 3:7; before, ὅτι, At 20:35.†
(AS)

G5264.def:
ὑπο-δέχομαι
[in LXX: Tob.7:8-9 Jdth.13:13 A, 1Ma.16:15, 4Ma.13:17 * ;]
to receive under one's roof, receive as a guest, entertain hospitably: with accusative of person(s), Lc 19:6, At 17:7, Tg 2:25; εἰς τ. οἶκον, Lc 10:38 (see MM, xxv).†
(AS)

G5265.def:
ὑπο-δέω
[in LXX: 2Cr 28:15, Eze.16:10 (נָעַל) * ;]
to blind under, esp. of foot gear. Most frequently in mid, and pass. with accusative;
__(a) of the foot, ὑποδησάμενοι τ. πόδας, your feet shod: Ef 6:15;
__(b) of that which is put on, σανδάλια: Mc 6:9, At 12:8.†
(AS)

G5266.def:
ὑπόδημα, -τος, τό
(ὑποδέω), [in LXX for נָעַל ;]
a sole bound under the foot, a sandal: Mt 3:11 10:10, Mc 1:7, Lc 3:16 10:4 15:22 22:35, Jo 1:27; τ. ποδῶν, At 7:33 (LXX) At 13:25.†
SYN.: σανδάλιον, q.v (AS)

G5267.def:
ὑπόδικος, -ον
brought to trial, answerable to: with dative of person(s), τ. θεῷ, Rm 3:19 (see MM, xxv).†
(AS)

G5268.def:
ὑπο-ζύγιος, -α, -ον
[in LXX for חֲמוֹר ;]
under the yoke; as subst., τ . (Hdt., al.), a beast of burden; colloq., an ass (see Deiss., BS, 160 f.), and so always in LXX and NT: Mt 21:5 (LXX), 2Pe 2:16.†
(AS)

G5269.def:
ὑπο-ζώννυμι
[in LXX: 2Ma.3:19 * ;]
to undergird (Hdt., al.; ὑπὸ τ. μάστους, 2Mac, l.with); of a ship, to undergird or frap: At 27:17 (see DB, ext. 367a).†
(AS)

G5270.def:
ύπο-κάτω comp. adv. (see M, Pr., 99),
[in LXX chiefly for תַּחַת ;]
below, under: as prep. with genitive, Mt 22:44, Mc 6:11 7:28 12:36 (Rec., R, txt., ὑποπόδιον, as in LXX), Lc 8:16, Jo 1:51, Hb 2:8" (LXX), Ap 5:3, 13 6:9 12:1.†
(AS)

G5271.def:
ὑπο-κρίνομαι
[in LXX: (Jó 40:2) אּ1 (AB אּ2 ἀπο-, עָנָה), Sir.1:29 35:15 (32:15) Sir.36:2 (33:2), 2Ma.5:25 2Mac 6:21 2Mac 6:24, 4Ma.6:15 4Mac 6:17 * ;]
__1. = Att.. ἀποκρίνομαι (which see), to answer, reply (Hom., Hdt., al.).
__2. to answer on the stage, play apart (Arist., al.). Metaphorical, to feign, pretend (Demos., Polyb.): with accusative and inf., Lc 20:20 (cf. Ps sol 4:22).†
(AS)

G5272.def:
ὑπό-κρισις, -εως, ἡ
(ὑποκρίνομαι, which see) [in LXX: 2Ma.6:25 * ;]
__1. a reply, answer (Hdt.).
__2. play-acting (Arist., Polyb., al.). Metaphorical, pretence, hypocrisy: Mt 23:28, Mc 12:15, Lc 12:1, Gl 2:13, 1Tm 4:2, 1Pe 2:1 (Polyb., Pss Ct 4:7).†
(AS)

G5273.def:
ὑπο-κριτής, -οῦ, ὁ
(ὑποκρίνομαι, which see) [in LXX Jó 34:30 36:13 (חָנֵף) * ;]
__1. one who answers, an interpreter (Plat.).
__2. a stage player, actor (Plut., Xen., al.). Metaphorical (in LXX and NT), a pretender, dissembler, hypocrite: Mt 6:2, 5 6:16 7:5 15:7 22:18 23:13-15 24:51, Mc 7:6 Lc 6:42 12:56 13:15.†
(AS)

G5274.def:
ὑπο-λαμβάνω
[in LXX: Jó 2:4 4:1 and frequently (עָנָה), Sl 48:9 (דָּמָה pi.), Tob.6:17, Wis.17:2, 3Ma.3:8 3Mac 3:11, al. ;]
__1. to take or bear up (by supporting from beneath): with accusative of person(s), At 1:9.
__2. to receive, welcome, entertain (Xen.): III Jn 8.
__3. to catch up in speech (Hdt., al.; Jb, ll. with): Lc 10:30.
__4. Of mental action, to assume, suppose (Xen., al.; To, Wis, 3Mac, ll. with): At 2:15; before ὅτι (see Bl., § 70, 2), Lc 7:43.†
(AS)

G5275.def:
ὑπο-λείπω
[in LXX chiefly (pass.) for יָתַר ni., שָׁאַר ni. ;]
to leave remaining (Hom., Thuc., al.): pass., of survivors, Rm 11:3.†
(AS)

G5276.def:
ὑπολήνιον, -ου, τό
(ὑπό, ληνός), [in LXX: Jl 3:13 (4:13), Ag 2:17, (16), Zc 14:10, Is 16:10 (יֶקֶב) * ;]
a vessel or trough beneath a winepress to receive the juice (RV, a pit for the winepress): Mc 12:1 (see Swete, in l, and cf. ληνός).†
(AS)

G5277.def:
ὑπο-λιμτάνω
collat. form of ὑπολείπω,
to leave behind: 1Pe 2:21.†
(AS)

G5278.def:
ὑπο-μένω
[in LXX chiefly for קָוָה, also for יָחַל hi., etc. ;]
__1. in-trans., to stay behind: before ἐν, Lc 2:43; ἐκεῖ, At 17:14.
__2. Trans.,
__(a) with accusative, to await, wait for: Rm 8:24 (Hom., Hdt., Xen., al.);
__(b) of things, to bear patiently, endure: absol., Mt 10:22 24:13, Mc 13:13, 2Tm 2:12, Tg 5:11, 1Pe 2:20; τ. θλίψει (dative of circumstance), Rm 12:12; before εἰς, Hb 12:7; with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 13:7, 2Tm 2:10, Hb 10:32 12:2-3, Tg 1:12.†
SYN.: μακροθυμέω (see: ὑπομονή) (AS)

G5279.def:
ὑπο-μιμνήσκω
[in LXX: 3Ki.4:3 B ( hi.), Wis.12:1 18:22, 4Ma.18:14 * ;]
to cause one to remember, put one in mind or remind one of: with accusative of thing(s), 2Tm 2:14, 3Jn.10; with dupl. accusative (Thus., al.), Jo 14:26; with accusative of person(s), before περί, 2Pe 1:12; id., before ὅτι, Ju 5; with inf., Tt 3:1; pass., with genitive of thing(s), Lc 22:61.†
(AS)

G5280.def:
ὑπόμινησις, -εως, ἡ
(ὑπομιμνήσκω) [in LXX: Sl 71:6 א (תְּהִלָּה), Wis.16:11, 2Ma.6:17 * ;]
a reminding, reminder: ἐν ὑ., 2Pe 1:13 3:1; with genitive, 2Tm 1:5.†
(AS)

G5281.def:
ὑπο-μονή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑπομένω) [in LXX for מִקְוֶה and cogn. forms; frequently in 4Mac ;]
__1. a remaining behind (Arist.).
__2. patient enduring, endurance: Lc 8:15 21:19, Rm 5:3-4 15:4-5, 2Co 6:4 12:12, Cl 1:11, 2Ts 1:4, 1Tm 6:11, 2Tm 3:10, Tt 2:2, Hb 10:36, Tg 1:3-4 5:11, 2Pe 1:6, Ap 2:2-3, 19 13:10 14:12; δι᾽ ὑπομονῆς, Rm 8:25, Hb 12:1; with genitive of person(s), 2Ts 3:5 (ICC, in l), Ap 3:10; with genitive of thing(s), Rm 2:7, 2Co 1:6, 1Ts 1:3; before ἐν, Ap 1:9.†
SYN.: see: μακροθυμία, and cf. Hort on Tg 1:3 (AS)

G5282.def:
ὑπο νοέω, -ῶ
[in LXX: Da TH Dn 7:25 (סְבַר), Tob.8:16, Jdth.14:14, Sir.23:21 * ;]
to suspect, conjecture: At 25:18; with accusative and inf., At 13:25 27:27.†
(AS)

G5283.def:
ὑπόνοια, -ας, ἡ
(ὑπονοέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 4:16, 32 5:6 (רַעְיוֹן), Sir 3:34* ;]
a suspicion: 1Tm 6:4.†
(AS)

G5284.def:
ὑπο-πλέω
to sail under, i.e. under the lee of: with accusative, At 27:4, 7.†
(AS)

G5285.def:
ὑπο-πνέω
__1. to blow underneath (Arist.).
__2. to blow gently: At 27:13.†
(AS)

G5286.def:
ὑποπόδιον, -ου, τό
(ὑπό, πούς), [in LXX: Sl 99:5 110:1, Is 66:1, La 2:1 (הֲדֹם) * ;]
a footstool (= cl. θρᾶνος): Tg 2:3; metaphorically, Mt 5:35, Mc 12:36 (ὑποκάτω, WH, R, mg.), Lc 20:43, At 2:35 7:49, Hb 1:13 10:13 (all, except Mt, l.with, from LXX, Sl 110:1, Is 66:1) (for exx., see Deiss., BS, 223).†
(AS)

G5287.def:
ὑπό-στασις, -εως, ἡ
(ὑφίστημι, to set under, stand under, support) [in LXX for מַצָּב (1Rs 13:23 14:4 B), תִּקְוָה (Rt 1:12, Eze.19:5), etc., also in Wis.16:21 ;]
__1. a support, base or foundation (in various senses).
__2. substance (Arist., al.; opposite to φαντασία, ἔμφασις): Hb 1:3
__3. steadiness, firmness (Polyb., al.), hence, assurance, confidence: 2Co 9:4 11:17, Hb 3:14 11:1 (here perhaps title-deed, as that which gives reality or guarantee; see MM, xxv).†
(AS)

G5288.def:
ὑπο-στέλλω
[in LXX: Dt 1:17 (גּוּר), Jó 13:8 (נָשָׂא פָּנִים), Hc 2:4 (עָפַל pu.), Ag 1:10 (כָּלָא), Êx 23:21, Wis.6:7, 3Ma.5:28 * ;]
__1. to draw in, let down (ἱστίον, οὐράν, etc.).
__2. to draw back, withdraw: ἑαυτόν, Gl 2:12 (Polyb., al.; see Lft., in l). Mid., to shrink or draw back: Hb 10:38 (LXX); before τοῦ, with inf., At 20:27; οὐδέν, At 20:20.†
(AS)

G5289.def:
ὑπο-στολή, -ῆς, ἡ
(ὑποστέλλω),
__1. a letting down, lowering (Plut.).
__2. a shrinking back (Hesych.): οὐκ ἐσμὲν ὑποστολῆς (on the genitive, see Bl., § 35, 2), Hb 10:39.†
(AS)

G5291.def:
ὑπο-στρωννύω
[in LXX: Is 58:5 (יָצָא hi.), etc. ;]
late form of ὑπο-στορέννυμι, to spread or strew under: with accusative of thing(s), Lc 19:36.†
(AS)

G5293.def:
ὑπο-τάσσω
[in LXX for דָבַר hi., דָּמַם, שׂוּם, שִׁית, etc. ;]
__1. as a military term, to place or rank under (Polyb.).
__2. to subject, put in subjection: 1Co 15:27, Fp 3:21, Hb 2:5, 8; pass., Rm 8:20, 1Co 15:27-28, 1Pe 3:22, Ef 1:22. Mid., to subject oneself, obey: absol., Rm 13:5, 1Co 14:34; with dative of person(s), Lc 2:51 10:17, 20, Rm 8:7 10:3 13:1, 1Co 14:32 15:28 (ὑποταγήσεται; cf. M, Pr., 163), 1Co 16:16, Ef 5:21-22 (T, WH, txt., R, om.), Ef 5:24, Cl 3:18, Tt 2:5, 9 3:1, Hb 12:9, 1Pe 2:18 3:1 3:5 5:5; imperat., Tg 4:7, 1Pe 2:13 5:5.†
(AS)

G5294.def:
ὑπο-τίθημι
[in LXX for שׂוּם, etc. ;]
to place under, lay down. Metaphorical, τ. τράχηλον ὑποθεῖναι, to risk one's life (see Deiss., LAE, 119 f.): Rm 16:4; mid., to suggest: 1Tm 4:6.†
(AS)

G5295.def:
ὑπο-τρέχω
to run in under; of navigators, to run in the lee of: with accusative (see M, Pr., 65), At 27:16.†
(AS)

G5296.def:
ὑπο-τύπωσις, -εως, ἡ
(ὑποτυπόω, to delineate),
an outline, sketch. Metaphorical, a pattern, example: 1Tm 1:16, 2Tm 1:13.†
SYN.: ὁμοίωμα, τύπος, ὑπόδειγμα (see DB, iii, 696b) (AS)

G5297.def:
ὑπο-φέρω
[in LXX for נָשָׂא, etc. ;]
to bear by being under. Metaphorical, to endure: with accusative of thing(s), 1Co 10:13, 2Tm 3:11, 1Pe 2:19.†
(AS)

G5298.def:
ὑπο-χωρέω
[in LXX: Jz 20:37 B (-), Sir.13:9, 2Ma.12:12 * ;]
to go back, retire: before ἐν, Lc 5:16; before εἰς, Lc 9:10.†
(AS)

G5299.def:
ὑπωπιάζω
(ὑπώπιον, (a) the part of the face below the eyes; (b) a blow on the face),
to strike under the eye, give a black eye:
metaphorically,
__(a) of persistent annoyance (RV, wear out), Lc 18:6;
__(b) of severe self-discipline (R, txt. buffet, mg. bruise), 1Co 9:27 (see Field, Notes, 71, 174).†
ὑπο-πιάζω,
later form of ὑποπιέζω, to press slightly; metaphorically,
to repress: 1Co 9:27 T.7 for ὑπωπιάζω, which see†
(AS)
